justification: Assessment reported INVALID. Its headline flawed step is step (iii) ('s has no net inflow' => |f| = sum of f(s,y) over out-edges), a genuine break that I verified on its own witness: with f routing 1 unit around s->b->c->s plus 1 on s->a->t, |f| = 1 but the proof's formula gives 2, and |g|-|f| = 4 while the proof's displayed sum gives 3. Separately, its reasoning_summary states as a second independent break exactly the ground-truth defect: line 0063's per-edge identity g(x,y)-f(x,y) = h(x,y)-h(y,x) is self-contradictory on antiparallel edges (u,v),(v,u), since adding the two instances cancels the LHS and forces (g-f)(u,v)+(g-f)(v,u)=0; its witness f(u,v)=5,g(u,v)=2,f(v,u)=0,g(v,u)=1 gives -3+1 = -2 != 0, and h is double-assigned on arc (v,u) (3 and 1). That is the same defect and the same mechanism as the ground-truth witness (antiparallel pair (a,b),(b,a) forcing A+B = 1 != 0 and double-assigning h(b,a)), with a different but valid witness. Hence CAUGHT_MATCHING rather than CAUGHT_DIFFERENT.
